name: Carrier AquaForce 30XF variable-speed air-cooled screw chiller
description: Air-cooled VFD screw chiller with optional hydronic free cooling (FreeBoost), R1234ze/R515B/R513A/R134a, active harmonic filter, ATS, 120 s recovery to full load. First free-cooling process chiller with Eurovent data-centre certification. Range entry: size not fixed.

capacity_w.note: nominal range across sizes 738-2520 kW; Carrier data-centre brochure bases capacity on 20 C LWT and 35 C outdoor air

cop.note: 'COP up to 3.9' at data-centre condition 30 C EWT / 20 C LWT, 35 C ambient, without free cooling (carrier-dc-page); the product page states 'COP up to 3.3' with unstated (likely standard 12/7 C) conditions

sources.title: Carrier data centers page (India): AquaForce 30XF COP up to 3.9
